protocol: 4-episode probe on seeds 11..14 and full 20-episode official benchmark on seeds 11..30 (reset_mode=mixed, task_phase=target, 1000 steps, published v9 world, scored on the unmodified published reward by bench_approach_mechanism.trace_episode) comparing the published CEM teachers against Gait-MPC configurations (strict z > 1.0 m locomotion gate, stability_weight=60, 5-step knot hold, slew-rate regularisation, and two-state settled-standing fall termination), plus 28-episode student imitation / offline-critic transfer (seeds 101..128), 200k-step online SAC warm-start, decoupled upright-reset & hybrid recovery-supervisor evaluations (benchmarks/gait_standing_and_supervisor_eval.json), and within-plan centered Q(s, a) reconciliation on benchmarks/demos/mpc_candidates.npz

mpc_elite_mean_48x3_h100.protocol: cross-entropy MPC (action=elite-mean, samples=48, iterations=3, horizon=100, elite=12, replan=20) rolled out on 4 episodes with reset_mode=mixed, task_phase=target, WalkerRagdoll-v0 in the published world, scored with envs.reward_shaping.TRAINING_REWARD_KWARGS

gait_smooth_v08.label: Gait MPC, smooth in-band gate (no rollout-termination latch), v_ref=0.8 m/s

gait_settled_v11.label: Gait MPC, settled-standing fall termination + v_ref=1.1 m/s (cont_decay=0.90)

gait_settled_v08.label: Gait MPC, settled-standing fall termination + strict v_ref=0.8 m/s (cont_decay=0.80)

findings.why_paying_below_band_is_inverted: envs/walker_ragdoll_env.py sets stand_height = clip((z - 0.65)/0.60, 0, 1), so locomotion terms already pay up to 58.3% below the z = 1.0 m standing band; paying more locomotion below the band rewards lunging and crawling, whereas zeroing locomotion outside (z > 1.0, upright > 0.7) forces the planner to stand before advancing.
findings.two_state_termination_rule: Enabling terminate_when_unhealthy=True unconditionally inside _evaluate() arms _ever_healthy on the first frame z crosses 1.001 m during a dynamic stand-up from the floor and punishes the subsequent settling wobble by -500. Enabling it only when plan() starts already settled in standing posture (z0 > 1.12 m, upright0 > 0.80) prevents diving from a stand without booby-trapping recovery.
findings.layer3_gait_verdict: Under the corrected gait objective, in-band time rises from 12.1%-18.2% to 41.2%-54.2%, continuous standing runs reach 2.98 s-3.02 s (crossing the 2.0 s threshold no published MPC or learned arm had crossed), and the share of approach closed while standing rises from 0.279 to 0.612 (at v_ref=1.1 m/s) and 1.018 (at v_ref=0.8 m/s, 11.95 m closed standing vs -0.21 m while down).
findings.layer1_action_imitability_verdict: Holding control knots for 5 steps with slew-rate regularisation cuts consecutive-action MSE by 6x-11x (0.7567 -> 0.0703-0.1252, dropping from 1.99x action energy to 0.38x-0.39x) and allows a held-out ridge regressor to beat the constant-zero predictor by 10.85%-12.64% where both argmin and 1-step elite-mean previously lost.
findings.layer2_q_probe_verdict: Fixing the missing prediction centering in bench_planner_q.within_state_metrics and centering training returns per plan puts state_only at 0.0000 by construction (instead of -2.095) and raises joint_interactions on mpc_candidates.npz from within_r2 = -3.168 (pearson 0.0043) to within_r2_centered = +0.0130 (pearson +0.1152), matching the theoretical ~1/H = 1% variance share of a 1-step action in a 100-step random rollout. Even with 5-step knots (pearson +0.1500), the pre-registered Q(s, a) gate (>= 0.30 R2, >= 0.50 pearson, >= 0.50 elite hit) remains closed.
findings.layer4_decoupled_recovery_and_upright_ve: Decoupling stand-up recovery from in-band walking on seeds 11..30 shows both why the students fail on mixed resets and why removing fallen resets is not enough by itself: under reset_mode='upright' (20/20 starts in band), BC median returns rise 10x (+1326.60 -> +13439.65 for bc_gait_raw, +1341.75 -> +12673.56 for bc_gait_band) and distance closed while standing rises 14x-33x (0.09 m -> 3.01 m and 0.31 m -> 4.39 m, 27.1% standing share), but open-loop covariate shift inside the standing gait cycle still topples the student after 0.81 s-0.85 s (4.72%-4.89% of steps in band, 0/20 target arrivals vs 8.07 s and 12.98 m standing for 40M-step walker_target_v1). Pairing the 20M-step recovery expert (walker_recovery_v1) with the students on reset_mode='mixed' cuts episodes_never_in_band from 18/20 to 8/20, lifts in-band time up to 35x-46x (0.325% -> 14.88% for rec+bc_gait_raw at z > 1.15 m, upright > 0.85; 0.365% -> 12.86% with a 2.25 s continuous standing run for rec+bc_gait_band), and raises standing distance closed to 2.22 m (rec+bc_gait_raw at z > 1.1 m, upright > 0.8), but handoff chattering between the 49-D student and the 46-D target-blind recovery policy keeps target arrivals at 0/20.
